title: verify_response
description: Response body for POST /v1/audit/receipts/{run_id}/verify (FR-018). Mirrors Recurse.Gateway.Admin.LocalVerifyHandler.run_checks_and_respond/3 + check_to_json/1. Carries the 5-step cryptographic verification result the SPA renders as five rows in the Verify Locally tab. Each check name + step number is fixed by the FR-018 contract; status atom is pass|fail; explanation is human-readable text the SPA renders verbatim under the row.

run_id.description: Receipt being verified — matches the {run_id} path parameter.

overall_status.description: Aggregate boolean: pass iff every check in `checks` passed; fail otherwise. Stringified atom from the backend.

checks.description: Five-step verification result; ordered by step (1..5).

name.description: Backend check identifier; SPA maps to the row testId + label via CHECK_ORDER.

explanation.description: Backend-emitted human-readable explanation. The SPA renders this verbatim; auditors must be able to reproduce the result without server access (e.g., expected/actual hex hashes on mismatch, algorithm + key id on success).

verified_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the server completed the checks.

tier_completeness_advisory.description: Tier-completeness advisory copied from the receipt; nullable. Discovery-tier Standalone is always partial.
